title: PCD: Predictive Coding Dynamics for Irregularly Sampled Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2610.41506v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamic systems evolve continuously over time, whereas observations in real scenarios are often sparse, irregular, and asynchronous. Accurate prediction therefore requires inferring latent state evolution between observations, as future values depend on partially observed trajectories. We propose Predictive Coding Dynamics (PCD), a residual feedback mechanism for irregular continuous dynamic models. PCD maintains previous reconstructions, predicts observed entries from them, and incorporates masked signed residuals into state recognition through an energy penalty. The mechanism is implemented with ODE-RNN and Latent ODE, supporting event-based hidden updates and latent state recognition. Experiments on forecasting and trajectory recovery tasks show that PCD improves continuous dynamic backbones under sparse and irregular sampling. translated_title: PCD：面向不规则采样时间序列的预测编码动力学
translated_abstract: 动态系统随时间连续演化，而真实场景中的观测往往是稀疏、不规则且异步的。因此，准确的预测需要推断观测之间的潜在状态演化，因为未来取值依赖于部分观测到的轨迹。我们提出了预测编码动力学，这是一种针对不规则连续动态模型的残差反馈机制。PCD 保留先前的重构结果，据此预测观测到的条目，并通过能量惩罚将带符号的掩码残差融入状态识别过程。该机制以 ODE-RNN 和 Latent ODE 实现，支持基于事件的隐状态更新与潜在状态识别。在预测和轨迹恢复任务上的实验表明，PCD 在稀疏和不规则采样条件下提升了连续动态骨干模型的性能。结果进一步表明，当观测[有限时]，预测误差反馈能够改善潜在状态估计。
tldr: PCD 提出了一种残差反馈机制，通过保留先前重构、预测观测值并将带符号掩码残差经能量惩罚融入状态识别，显著提升了 ODE-RNN 和 Latent ODE 等连续动态模型在稀疏不规则采样时间序列上的预测与轨迹恢复性能。
